## Calculate marker positive cell type proportions
```{r}
# Function to filter data, calculate proportions for specified cell types, remove "negative" columns, and rename "positive" columns
process_celltype_proportions <- function(df, df_clin_metadata, counts_per_x, unique_regions_column, cell_types_filter, celltype_columns) {
  
  # Filter dataframe for the specified cell type
  df_filt <- df %>% filter(cell_types_lowres %in% cell_types_filter)
  
  # Initialize list to store results for each Celltype_column
  total_counts_percent_list <- list()
  
  for (Celltype_column in celltype_columns) {
    # Generate count of celltype per region
    df2 <- df_filt %>%
      group_by_at(c(Celltype_column, unique_regions_column)) %>%
      summarise(Count = n())
    
    # Reshape to wide format
    df3 <- as.data.frame(acast(df2, as.formula(paste0(unique_regions_column, "~", Celltype_column)), value.var = "Count"))
    df3$unique_core_num <- rownames(df3)
    df3[is.na(df3)] <- 0  # Replace NAs with 0

    # Combine clinical metadata with counts per unique region
    composite <- right_join(df_clin_metadata, df3, by = "unique_core_num")
    
    # Prepare dataframe for proportions
    df_intermed <- cbind(composite[, counts_per_x], composite[, (ncol(df_clin_metadata) + 1):ncol(composite)])
    names(df_intermed)[1] <- "ID"
    df_intermed$ID <- as.factor(df_intermed$ID)
    
    # Create a list to store data by ID
    df_list <- list()
    for (i in df_intermed$ID) {
      df3 <- df_intermed %>% filter(ID == i)
      df3 <- df3[2:ncol(df3)]
      if (nrow(df3) > 1) {
        df3[is.na(df3)] <- 0
        intermed <- as.data.frame(colSums(df3))
        df_list[[i]] <- t(intermed)
      } else {
        intermed <- as.data.frame(df3[1, ])
        df_list[[i]] <- intermed
      }
    }
    
    # Combine into one dataframe
    df_list_t <- t(df_list)
    sums <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, df_list_t))
    rownames(sums) <- colnames(df_list_t)
    sums <- tibble::rownames_to_column(sums, counts_per_x)
    total_counts <- sums[, -1]
    total_counts[is.na(total_counts)] <- 0
    total_counts_percent <- (total_counts / rowSums(total_counts)) * 100
    total_counts_percent$ID <- sums[, 1]
    names(total_counts_percent)[names(total_counts_percent) == "ID"] <- counts_per_x

    # Remove all columns with "negative" in the name
    total_counts_percent <- total_counts_percent %>% dplyr::select(-contains("negative"))

    # Rename "positive" columns to include both Celltype_column and cell_types_filter
    colnames(total_counts_percent) <- gsub("positive", paste0(Celltype_column, "_", cell_types_filter), colnames(total_counts_percent))

    # Store the result
    total_counts_percent_list[[Celltype_column]] <- total_counts_percent
  }
  
  # Combine results for all cell types
  combined_total_counts_percent <- cbind(total_counts_percent_list)
  
  return(combined_total_counts_percent)
}

# Define cell type filters and cell type columns to process
cell_type_filters <- list(
  "tumor" = c("EZH2_pos", "EMT_pos", "Hypoxic_pos", "Ki67_pos", "PDL1_cluster_pos"),
  "T_lymphocytes" = c("TCF17_pos", "T_cell_memory", "Exhausted_cluster", "Resident_T_cell_pos", "Ki67_pos"),
  "myeloid_cells" = c("HLADR_pos", "CXCL9_pos", "IL10_pos", "PDL1_cluster_pos")
)

# Run function for each cell type filter and combine results
results_list <- lapply(names(cell_type_filters), function(cell_type) {
  process_celltype_proportions(
    df = df_TTM_baseline,
    df_clin_metadata = df_clin_metadata,
    counts_per_x = "Pat_ID",
    unique_regions_column = "unique_core_num",
    cell_types_filter = cell_type,
    celltype_columns = cell_type_filters[[cell_type]]
  )
})

data_frames_list <- list()

# Iterate over results_list to extract and save data frames
count <- 1  # Initialize a counter for naming the data frames

for (i in seq_along(results_list)) {
  for (j in seq_along(results_list[[i]])) {
    # Extract the data frame
    df4 <- results_list[[i]][[j]]
    
    # Check if the data frame is not empty
    if (!is.null(df4) && nrow(df4) > 0) {
      # Create a dynamic variable name (df_list_1, df_list_2, ..., df_list_14)
      var_name <- paste0("df_list_", count)
      assign(var_name, df4, envir = .GlobalEnv)  
      count <- count + 1  
    }
  }
}

# Check the saved data frames in the global environment
ls(pattern = "df_list_")

combined_df <- df_list_1  # Start with the first data frame

# List of data frames to combine
df_list_names <- paste0("df_list_", 2:14)

# Iterate over the list of data frame names
for (df_name in df_list_names) {
  # Get the data frame by name using get()
  df_to_merge <- get(df_name)
  
  # Check if the data frame contains the 'Pat_ID' column
  if ("Pat_ID" %in% colnames(df_to_merge)) {
    # Merge the current data frame with the combined data frame by 'Pat_ID'
    combined_df <- merge(combined_df, df_to_merge, by = "Pat_ID", all = TRUE)
  } else {
    message(paste(df_name, "does not contain 'Pat_ID' column. Skipping..."))
  }
}

# Check the combined data frame
print(combined_df)
```

## Calculate major cell type and CN proportions
```{r}
df_TTM_baseline <- df %>% filter(Local_disease == 1 & Baseline_FU_biopsy == "pre")

# Function to calculate proportions for cell_types_mediumres and CN_k20_n25
process_celltype_proportions_unfiltered <- function(df, df_clin_metadata, counts_per_x, unique_regions_column, celltype_columns) {
  
  # Initialize list to store results for each Celltype_column
  total_counts_percent_list <- list()
  
  # Function to calculate percentages
  calculate_percentages <- function(data) {
    total_counts <- data[,-1]  # Remove ID or relevant identifier column
    total_counts[is.na(total_counts)] <- 0
    total_counts_percent <- (total_counts / rowSums(total_counts)) * 100
    total_counts_percent <- cbind(data[[1]], total_counts_percent)  # Add ID back
    return(total_counts_percent)
  }
  
  # Calculate for unfiltered cell_types_mediumres and CN_k20_n25 columns
  for (Celltype_column in celltype_columns) {
    # Generate count of celltype per region for unfiltered data
    df2 <- df %>%
      group_by_at(c(Celltype_column, unique_regions_column)) %>%
      summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")
    
    # Proceed only if there are counts to process
    if (nrow(df2) > 0) {
      # Reshape to wide format
      df3 <- as.data.frame(acast(df2, as.formula(paste0(unique_regions_column, "~", Celltype_column)), value.var = "Count"))
      df3$unique_core_num <- rownames(df3)
      df3[is.na(df3)] <- 0  # Replace NAs with 0
      
      # Combine clinical metadata with counts per unique region
      composite <- right_join(df_clin_metadata, df3, by = "unique_core_num")
      
      # Prepare dataframe for proportions
      df_intermed <- cbind(composite[, counts_per_x], composite[, (ncol(df_clin_metadata) + 1):ncol(composite)])
      names(df_intermed)[1] <- "ID"
      df_intermed$ID <- as.factor(df_intermed$ID)
      
      # Create a list to store data by ID for unfiltered data
      df_list <- list()
      for (i in df_intermed$ID) {
        df3 <- df_intermed %>% filter(ID == i)
        df3 <- df3[2:ncol(df3)]
        if (nrow(df3) > 1) {
          df3[is.na(df3)] <- 0
          intermed <- as.data.frame(colSums(df3))
          df_list[[i]] <- t(intermed)
        } else if (nrow(df3) == 1) {
          intermed <- as.data.frame(df3[1, ])
          df_list[[i]] <- intermed
        }
      }
      
      # Combine into one dataframe
      df_list_t <- t(df_list)
      sums <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, df_list_t))
      rownames(sums) <- colnames(df_list_t)
      sums <- tibble::rownames_to_column(sums, counts_per_x)
      
      # Calculate percentages for unfiltered data
      total_counts_percent_unfiltered <- calculate_percentages(sums)
      
      # Store the result with a distinguishing name
      total_counts_percent_list[[Celltype_column]] <- total_counts_percent_unfiltered
    } else {
      warning(paste("No data available for column:", Celltype_column))
    }
  }
  
  # Combine results for all cell types
  combined_total_counts_percent <- do.call(cbind, total_counts_percent_list)
  
  return(combined_total_counts_percent)
}

# Define columns to process
celltype_columns <- c("cell_types_mediumres", "CN_k20_n25")

# Run function for unfiltered data
results_unfiltered <- process_celltype_proportions_unfiltered(
  df = df_TTM_baseline,
  df_clin_metadata = df_clin_metadata,
  counts_per_x = "Pat_ID",
  unique_regions_column = "unique_core_num",
  celltype_columns = celltype_columns
)

df_cell_types_mediumres <- results_unfiltered
# Rename the first column to "Pat_ID"
colnames(df_cell_types_mediumres)[1] <- "Pat_ID"

# Remove the string before the "." in all column names
colnames(df_cell_types_mediumres) <- gsub(".*\\.", "", colnames(df_cell_types_mediumres))
df_cell_types_mediumres <- df_cell_types_mediumres %>% 
  dplyr::select(-`data[[1]]`)
```

## Dichotomize the groups by the median
```{r}
cols <- colnames(df_KM_plots2)[2:51]

perform = TRUE


if(perform == TRUE) {
 for (x in cols) {
  # The `as.numeric` function is applied to each column of `df_KM_plots[x]`.
  # `cbind.data.frame` combines the resulting numeric vectors into a data frame.
  df_KM_plots2[x] <- do.call(cbind.data.frame, lapply(df_KM_plots2[x], as.numeric))
  # `test_df` is a data frame that contains only the column `x` of `all_data`.
  test_df <- df_KM_plots2[, x]
  # The first element of `test_df` is converted to a numeric vector.
  test_vec <- test_df
  # The NA values are removed from `test_vec`.
  test_vec <- test_vec[!is.na(test_vec)]
  # The median of `test_vec` is calculated.
  test_vec_median <- median(test_vec)
  # A string containing the name of `x` and its median value is printed.
  print(paste0(x, " ", "Median:", " ", as.character(test_vec_median)))
  # A new column named `x_group` is added to `df_KM_plots`.
  # It takes the value "high" if the corresponding value in column `x` is greater than `test_vec_median`, and "low" otherwise.
  df_KM_plots2[, paste0(x, "_group")] <- ifelse(df_KM_plots2[, x] > test_vec_median, "high", "low")
} 
}
```

## Figure 6K: PCA scores for DM vs no distant metastasis
```{r}
pdata = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/sorted_pdata_MCC.csv")
data = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/sorted_counts_MCC.csv", row.names = 1)

pdata$library.name == colnames(data)

pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease <- ifelse(pdata$Baseline_FU_biopsy != "pre" | pdata$Local_disease != 1, NA, pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)

data2 = data[,!(is.na(pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease))]
pdata2 = pdata[!(is.na(pdata$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)),]

pdata2$Progress_to_metastatic_disease

phenotypes = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/scripts/LCMseq_analysis/Phenotypes_scores_list.csv",header = T)
phenotypes[phenotypes == ""] = NA 
phenotypes = as.list(phenotypes, na.rm = T)
phenotypes = lapply(phenotypes, na.omit)
phenotypes = lapply(phenotypes, toupper)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

my_comparisons <- list( c("0", "1"))

res = data.frame(patient = pdata2$Pat_ID, type = pdata2$Progress_to_metastatic_disease)

## Boxplots corrected for multiple hypothesis testing
for(element in names(phenotypes)){
  to_PCA = data2[rownames(data2) %in% phenotypes[[element]],]
  to_PCA = log2(t(to_PCA+1))
  PCA = prcomp(to_PCA,scale. = T)
  coeff[[element]] = PCA$rotation
  res[[element]] = PCA$x[,1]
  
  to_plot = data.frame(type = pdata2$Progress_to_metastatic_disease,
                       PC1_scores = PCA$x[,1])
  
  to_plot$type = factor(to_plot$type)

  stat.test <- to_plot %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste0("PC1_scores", " ~ ", "type"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = )

# Print the results of the statistical test
  stat.test
  
  colors <- c("white", "black")
  
# Create a box plot with jittered points for each column in "cols"
  to_plot %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(x = type, y = PC1_scores, fill = "type") +
    stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", linetype = 1, width = 0.03, lwd = 0.7, color = "#333333") +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = colors, width = 0.4, lwd = 1) +
    geom_point(colour = "black", fill = "white", size = 1.6, position = position_jitter(w = 0.18, h = 0), shape = 21, stroke = 1.0) +
    theme_prism(base_size = 10)+
    labs(y = paste0(element, " percentage"), title = element) +
    xlab("Distant.metastasis")+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("no", "yes")) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test,
                       label = "p.adj",
                       label.size = 5,
                       fontface = "italic",
                       bracket.size = 1)
  ggsave(paste0('PCA_score_',element,'.pdf'), width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```
